brand.name: Adam Rędzikowski
brand.tagline: Analysis, design, code and deployment – all from one person.

hero.lead: I design and build custom websites and applications. I start with the problem and the way you work, then take care of the interface, the code, the launch and everything that comes after. Below are some of my projects – each one can be opened in the browser or downloaded.

projects.title: Selected work
projects.lead: Every project has its own architecture, interface and back end. None of them was built on an off-the-shelf theme.

catalog.title: Everything I have built
catalog.lead: Web services you can open in the browser and applications you can download. App files come straight from the latest releases – not from a hand-maintained list.

scope.title: How I can
scope.lead: I don't sell ready-made packages. First we work out what you actually need, then I pick the right solution – sometimes that's a single website, sometimes software that makes everyday work in your company easier.

items.title: Websites
items.lead: A website that looks like you and does what you expect it to.
items.detail: Company websites, portfolios, online shops and blogs. I take care of everything: layout, graphics, copy, making the site easy to find on Google, and putting it live. I don't use ready-made templates, so nothing limits the design.

items.title: Business software and content management
items.lead: A tool shaped around the way you work – not the other way round.
items.detail: Browser-based systems for your business: orders and customers, documents, reports, staff accounts. For websites I also build a simple admin panel where you can change texts and photos yourself – no developer needed.

items.title: Desktop and mobile apps
items.lead: Software installed right on the device.
items.detail: I build applications for Windows, Android and macOS – with an installer and automatic updates. Several of them can be downloaded for free from my portfolio.

items.title: Dashboards and reports
items.lead: Numbers that show at a glance what's going on in your business.
items.detail: I pull data together from different places – spreadsheets, your online shop, accounting software – and turn it into clear charts and reports that update themselves. No more copying tables by hand.

items.title: Automation and AI
items.detail: I set up software to handle the boring tasks on its own: sorting documents, answering common questions, drafting texts or moving data between systems. I only suggest AI where it genuinely saves time.

items.title: Networks, servers and smart homes
items.lead: Home and office tech that simply works.
items.detail: I set up home servers and network storage, automatic backups, network-wide ad blocking, lighting and heating control, and secure access to your files from outside the house.

process.title: From the first conversation to
process.lead: I run the whole process personally, so business, design and technical decisions never drift apart between departments.

items.title: Conversation
items.text: You tell me what you need and how you work today. Together we decide what is really worth building.

items.title: Plan
items.text: I prepare the design: what the solution should include, how it will work and look. Before I start building, you know exactly what you'll get.

items.title: Build
items.text: I create a working version and show it to you as it grows, so you can test it on real examples.

items.title: Launch
items.text: I put the finished solution online or install it on your side, secure it and show you how to use it.

items.title: Care
items.text: I make sure everything keeps running, help when questions come up and add new features as your needs grow.

about.title: I don't start with a template. I start with
about.lead: I'm a data analyst, designer and developer. I combine skills that larger projects usually spread across several people.
about.text:
I lead each project myself – from the first conversation, through planning, design and programming, all the way to launch. I build websites, business software, admin panels for editing websites yourself, and desktop and mobile apps – always from scratch and tailored to specific needs.

Many of these things started from my own needs: I wanted to organise my travels, understand road traffic data or identify the stars in a photo of the night sky. That's why I know what software you use every day should feel like.

Photography is my other way of telling stories about places and people. After launch I can keep looking after your project, help you run it and keep developing it.
strengths: Apps for Windows, Android and macOS
Admin panels for editing your own site
Home networks, servers and smart homes

pagesSection.title: More about
pagesSection.lead: The two areas I work in most often. Each page shows examples, the scope of work and what working together looks like.

items.q: Do I need to know exactly what I want?
items.a: No. It's enough to describe the problem or the idea. I'll help you sort out your needs and turn them into a concrete plan.
A simple website or blog usually takes a few weeks. Larger software is built in stages. After our first conversation I'll give you a realistic timeline.

The price depends on what needs to be built. Before we start you get a description of the work, the timeline and the cost. If it makes sense to begin with a smaller version and expand it later, I'll tell you straight away.

items.q: Will I be able to edit the content myself?
items.a: Yes. If you need it, you'll get a simple admin panel where you can change texts, photos or prices without any programming knowledge.

items.q: Will it connect to the tools I already use?
items.a: Usually yes – for example payments, email, invoicing software or your customer database. Before I promise anything, I check that the integration will work reliably.

items.q: Can you improve a website or app I already have?
items.a: Yes. First I check what state it's in and tell you honestly whether it's better to keep developing it or to rebuild it.
Yes. Before we start we agree exactly what I hand over – code, passwords and access – so you're never dependent on me.
I can keep looking after the website or software, answer your questions and add new things. We agree the scope of support individually.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside Poland?
items.a: Yes. I work remotely and communicate in English. Calls, demos and project updates all happen online, so the distance doesn't matter.

contact.title: Tell me what you need.
contact.lead: You can come with a finished idea or just a problem. We'll talk about the goal, the users and the way you work, and I'll suggest a direction – without squeezing your project into a ready-made package.
